# Embedded skill: segmentation-drilldown

# Segmentation drilldown

Most business RCA happens here. Fleet-wide numbers are the start, not the answer.

Rank slices with the script on already-fetched tables.

## Panja runtime

```text
python scripts/contribution_analysis.py --input /tmp/slices.json
```

Rows: `dimension`, `before`, `after`. Rank by **share of total delta**, not % change of tiny bases.

## Method

```text
conversion ↓ 12%
    ↓ platform
Android ↓21%   iOS flat   Web flat
    ↓ app_version (on Android)
v6.7 ↓38%
    ↓ country (on Android v6.7)
India ↓45%   US ↓7%
```

One dimension at a time. After each split, recompute contribution. Do not chain filters until the table says that slice owns the move.

## Techniques

- Hierarchical drilldown
- Top movers by contribution
- Pareto: 2–3 slices explain ≥70% of |delta|
- Relative vs absolute contribution
- Simpson: overall fell but every platform rose → **mix shift**

## STOP

- 12-way group-by
- Ranking by percentage change of tiny N
- Declaring root cause from one dimension without the complementary slice
- User-id group-by
